backend_differences.camera: Sampled mount and model intrinsics match; Isaac body heave/roll/pitch may change world extrinsics.
backend_differences.historical_state: Realizations are reconstructed from source, seed and archived asset inventory; historical runs did not save initialization snapshots.
backend_differences.numeric_runtime: NumPy, SciPy and platform versions are recorded; cross-platform floating point may differ.
backend_differences.physics: PhysX replaces the custom bicycle model; dynamics, contact response and body motion differ.
backend_differences.renderer: Isaac RTX replaces Panda3D; RGB, shadows, materials and lighting are not pixel-identical.
backend_differences.trajectory: Commands and referee logic match, but different trajectories can change their timing and outcomes.
backend_differences.venue: SceneDR values are sampled identically; backend-specific scenery meshes and material responses differ.

render_profile.reason: 4 and 8 subframes retained stale marker ghosts in HDR lighting; 16 passed moving-camera projection.

metrics.primary: Original referee pass, geometric DOO, off-course, progress and time per matched case
metrics.physical_contacts: Unique PhysX car-cone contacts, separate from original geometric DOO
metrics.performance: Per-frame render, policy including raw-head capture, evidence write and physics time
metrics.timing_limits: No training; no claim of speedup; video/oracle export runs offline and is excluded
metrics.case_selection: All 41 predefined cases, including command ablations and prior failure
